visualCharacteristics.purpose: related-story cards: image beside date, category, title, optional description, CTA and reading time; the whole card is the link
visualCharacteristics.layout: two cards per row from 744px (image left, text right); in a narrow column (sidebar, under 480px wide) cards stack image above text
visualCharacteristics.notes: Date, category, description and reading time are optional fields.

contentPattern.structure: <picture> | date p, category p, title heading, optional description p, story link p (its text is the CTA label), optional reading-time p

usage: Related Content bands (full-bleed mist) and single cards in article sidebars.
reuseGuidance: Use for every list of cards linking to story / detail pages; omit fields the source card does not show.
